taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.source_trace: Resolve configure/write/read authority and whether routing/bindings bridge data across intended tenant vhosts or exchanges.
controls.implementation_branch: Evaluate configure, write and read regex permissions separately within the selected vhost, plus topic permissions when applicable. Exchange publication and queue consumption have different resources and routing decisions. A binding can connect otherwise permitted resources, so inspect its authority without assuming a successful connection grants access to all messages.
controls.operational_method: Use the protocol operation-to-resource map: for AMQP queue.bind, evaluate write on the queue and read on the exchange, separately from basic.publish and basic.consume checks. Include topic routing-key permissions where used. Retain vhost, effective user/backend and whether a connection caches permissions; after a grant change compare an existing connection with a fresh one. A generic successful publish cannot validate binding or consumer authority.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated broker with two owned tenants and synthetic messages; compare intended publish/consume and one forbidden binding or routing key.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An open AMQP connection or queue name is not message access; public shared exchanges may be intentional.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain vhost/resource/routing authority and retest intended bindings, delivery and cross-tenant denial.
